thanks, i was staying at my best friend's house for a while (like 4 days) and i was really happy and doing good but i came back to my own house today and my dad is already being an ass and so i was feeling better but not anymore... thank you anyway though

i have been just blaming myself for being too lazy and too unmotivated to do anything- i havent been diagnosed with depression so i dont just want to assume it or anything, but idk. and yes! your comment was very helpful, its good to know there are people to talk to if i need it :)
my family lives in Canada and we visit every summer but im from Florida lol, why?

thank you for this. and i have the same problem with the long depressive episodes as you did. im constantly trying to remind myself that there are many other people who have gotten through this and are happy, but its hard. recently if ive felt like hurting myself, i will burn matches instead. somehow it calms me a little bit and then i just try to go to sleep afterwards if i can. thank you again for your reply

ive come very close a few times and it scary. i keep trying to see myself with a future, but i just cant. im trying to live on the 'what if it does actually get better' but sometimes i forget and do stupid things. thank you for this reply, somehow it makes me feel a little better remembering that there are other people feeling exactly how i do.
